payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_prose_limit_hook.py::test_make_check_runs_the_tree_hook_and_a_commit_does_not stayed green with the criterion's own edit applied to Makefile. The claim was '`make check` runs the tree mode and skips the index mode, and a commit runs only the index mode. The witness reads `.pre-commit-config.yaml` and `Makefile`. One hook runs the tree mode with `stages: [manual]`, `pass_filenames: false` and `always_run: true`. The `prose-limit` hook declares no `stages`, so it still runs on commit.', and only that witness ran under the edit.
